chapterInfo.content:
17
Aaron poma fefɛ
1Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: 2Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no, na gyegye wɔn hɔ wɔn mpanimfie mu mpoma mmaako mmaako, mmapɔmma no nyinaa hɔ mpoma dummienu, sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie teɛ no, na twerɛtwerɛ wɔn din hyehyɛ wɔn mpoma no so. 3Aaron din na twerɛ hyɛ Lewi poma soɔ: Ɛfiri sɛ poma biara yɛ mpanimfie biara mu otitire no deɛ. 4#Eks 25.22 Na gya gu ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, Adanseɛ no anim, deɛ me ne mo hyia hɔ no. 5#Num 16.5, 7 Na ɔbarima a mɛyi no no poma bɛfefɛ, na mama me ho anwiinwii a Israelfoɔ nwiinwii tia mo no agyae. 6Na Mose kasa kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ no; na wɔn mmapɔmma no nyinaa memaa no mpoma mmaako mmaako; mpoma dummienu, sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie teɛ no; na Aaron poma wɔ wɔn mpoma no mu. 7Na Mose gyaa mpoma no guu AWURADE anim adanseɛ ntomadan no mu.
8Na adeɛ kyeeɛ a Mose kɔɔ adanseɛ ntomadan no mu no, na hwɛ, Aaron poma a ɛyɛ Lewi fie deɛ no afefɛ ayɛ frɔmfrɔm agu nhwiren na aso sorɔno aba abere. 9Na Mose tasee mpoma no nyinaa de firii AWURADE anim firii adi brɛɛ Israelfoɔ no nyinaa, na wɔhwɛe, na wɔn mu biara faa ne poma.
10 # Heb 9.4 Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Fa Aaron poma no sane bra Adanseɛ no anim na wɔmfa nsie, na ɛnyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ mma asoɔdenfoɔ no, na woatwa wɔn anwiinwii a wɔnwiinwii tia me no so, na wɔanwuwu. 11Na Mose yɛɛ saa. Sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ no no, saa ara na ɔyɛeɛ.
12Na Israelfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Hwɛ, yɛrewuwu, yɛresɛe, yɛn nyinaa resɛe! 13#Num 16.40 Obiara a ɔbɛn AWURADE tenabea no wu: Yɛn nyinaa nwie sa anaa?

pageProps.chapterText:
Na AWURADE kasa kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Kasa kyerɛ Israelfoɔ no, na gyegye wɔn hɔ wɔn mpanimfie mu mpoma mmaako mmaako, mmapɔmma no nyinaa hɔ mpoma dummienu, sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie teɛ no, na twerɛtwerɛ wɔn din hyehyɛ wɔn mpoma no so. Aaron din na twerɛ hyɛ Lewi poma soɔ: Ɛfiri sɛ poma biara yɛ mpanimfie biara mu otitire no deɛ. Na gya gu ahyiaeɛ ntomadan no mu, Adanseɛ no anim, deɛ me ne mo hyia hɔ no. Na ɔbarima a mɛyi no no poma bɛfefɛ, na mama me ho anwiinwii a Israelfoɔ nwiinwii tia mo no agyae. Na Mose kasa kyerɛɛ Israelfoɔ no; na wɔn mmapɔmma no nyinaa memaa no mpoma mmaako mmaako; mpoma dummienu, sɛdeɛ wɔn mpanimfie teɛ no; na Aaron poma wɔ wɔn mpoma no mu. Na Mose gyaa mpoma no guu AWURADE anim adanseɛ ntomadan no mu.
Na adeɛ kyeeɛ a Mose kɔɔ adanseɛ ntomadan no mu no, na hwɛ, Aaron poma a ɛyɛ Lewi fie deɛ no afefɛ ayɛ frɔmfrɔm agu nhwiren na aso sorɔno aba abere. Na Mose tasee mpoma no nyinaa de firii AWURADE anim firii adi brɛɛ Israelfoɔ no nyinaa, na wɔhwɛe, na wɔn mu biara faa ne poma.
Na AWURADE ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Fa Aaron poma no sane bra Adanseɛ no anim na wɔmfa nsie, na ɛnyɛ nsɛnkyerɛnneɛ mma asoɔdenfoɔ no, na woatwa wɔn anwiinwii a wɔnwiinwii tia me no so, na wɔanwuwu. Na Mose yɛɛ saa. Sɛdeɛ AWURADE hyɛɛ no no, saa ara na ɔyɛeɛ.
Na Israelfoɔ no ka kyerɛɛ Mose sɛ: Hwɛ, yɛrewuwu, yɛresɛe, yɛn nyinaa resɛe! Obiara a ɔbɛn AWURADE tenabea no wu: Yɛn nyinaa nwie sa anaa?

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
